I'm not force-pushing yet. Your launch instruction was to keep anything over 50 MB out of `release/2.3`'s history, and that is why this fix has to be a rewrite. But `git push --force-with-lease` rewrites a shared branch that two teammates have already fetched, and it can't be undone. So I'll do the local part now and ask before the push.

**Before the push**

This changes what the code's history contains, so it goes to a fix subagent rather than being done by hand. I'd resume the Task 4 implementer at its existing tier (round 1 of 5). The brief is only the review finding: remove `samples/full-season.zip` from `7c1d9e0` by amending it, keep `ferry/times.py` and `tests/test_times.py` unchanged, and do **not** push. The covering test file is `tests/test_times.py`.

The subagent would run:

<command>git log --stat -1 7c1d9e0 && git ls-remote origin release/2.3</command>
<command>git rev-list --objects --all | git cat-file --batch-check='%(objecttype) %(objectname) %(objectsize) %(rest)' | awk '$3 > 52428800'</command>

The second command confirms the zip is the only object over 50 MB, so the amend alone is enough.

<command>git branch backup/task4-7c1d9e0 7c1d9e0</command>
<command>git rm --cached samples/full-season.zip</command>
<command>git commit --amend --no-edit</command>
<command>git show --stat HEAD</command>
<command>uv run pytest -q tests/test_times.py</command>

The backup branch keeps the old commit recoverable. `--cached` leaves the working-tree copy of the zip alone, so it ends up untracked and nothing is deleted. I expect `2 passed` from the test run, and the subagent reports the command and its output. Then I dispatch the scoped re-review using `re-review-prompt.md`, with the new SHA, and check that `git show --stat HEAD` lists only `ferry/times.py` and `tests/test_times.py`.

There are no file edits on my side, and I'm not writing a ledger line yet because Task 4 isn't complete until the re-review is clean.

**Message to my partner**

Task 4's review found a real problem. Commit `7c1d9e0` includes `samples/full-season.zip` (310 MB), which the task never asked for. Step 5 pushed it to `release/2.3`, which the build servers clone nightly, so it breaks your 50 MB rule.

I've amended the commit locally to drop the zip and kept a backup branch, `backup/task4-7c1d9e0`. I have not pushed anything. A follow-up commit that deletes the file would leave the 310 MB in history, so the only real fix is to replace the remote tip:

`git push --force-with-lease origin release/2.3`

Please confirm before I run it, because it rewrites a shared branch:
- The two teammates who fetched `7c1d9e0` this morning will need `git fetch && git reset --hard origin/release/2.3`, or a rebase of any work on top of it, before they push anything. Otherwise they can reintroduce the file.
- The remote host may keep the old blob reachable by SHA until it garbage-collects, so the blob may stay on the remote and in those teammates' clones. If the 50 MB rule is about the host's storage, you may need to ask the host to prune it.
- Tell me whether you'd rather I notify the teammates or you do.

If you say go, I'll push with `--lease` pinned to `7c1d9e0` so it fails if anyone has pushed since, then continue with Task 5.
